text.en:
Merger ofNLSF and LIVECOR. NISF and LIVECOR shall be merged
into a non-stock, non-profit. body corporate to be kaown as Livecor. The new Livecor
shall be transferred and attached to the 1.B3P pursuant to the mandate of NLSF under R.A..
6657. As such. the NLSE employecs and personnel who are absorbed by the new
Livecor shall be accorded the same benefits. privileges and other entitlements similarly
recewved by the LBP employees and officers subject to certain conditions imposed by the
new Livecor Board.

Mandate. - The new Livecor shall undertake the promotion, generation
and development of livelihood and commutaty based enterprises primarily in agri-
business, including those in the Agrarian Reform Communities, that will cater to the low-
income bracket. It shail take charge of developing and administering livelihood
programs using the NLSF funds.

Additional Capital. - The new Livecor shall be infused with additional
capital of One Hundred Million Pesos (8100,000,000.00) chat shall he sourced from the
accumulated earnings of NISF
Functions and Composition of the Board of Directors of the news
Livecor. The Board of Directors of the new Livecor shall be the policy-making body
composed of the following:
a. The Secretary of Agriculture or las designee as ex-officio Chairman;
b. Executive Director of the NSF Secretariat as the ex-officio Vice-Chairman;
c. Nominee of President of the Philiptines as Member;
d. Nominee of the Department of Agrarian Reform, approved by the President of the
Philippines as Member, as Member.

e Nominee of the LBP, approved by the President of the Philippines, as Member;
f. Representative from the Labor Sector, appointed by the President of the
Philippines, as Member.
g. Nominee of the Department of the Interior and Local Government, approved by
the President of the Philippines, as Member,
The tern of the Members of the Board of Directors of the new Livecor shall be one (1)
year, and they shall serve in a hold-over capacity until their successors shall have been
appointed and qualified.

Oficers ofthe new Livecor. - The President of the new Livecer shall be
the Executive Director of the present NLSF Secretariat. The Vice-President. Corporate
Treasurer. the Corporate Secretary and other officers shall be elected by the Board ef
Directors in a meeting called for that purpose and approved by the President of the
Plalippines.

Transfer.
The administration and management of the NLSF shall be
transferred from the NLSF Management Committee to the new Livecor Board of
Directors for administration, management and development purposes
All powers, functions, rights and dunes previously exercised by the NLSE Management
Committee relating to the administration, management and development of NSF's
programs. assers. liabilities and records shall be transferred to and exercised by the new
Livecor Board of Directors.

Transfer Committee. - A Transfer Commitee composed of the Secretary
of Agriculture or his designee, the Executive Director of the NISF Secretariat a
representative each from the Office of the President, Department of Agrarian Reform and
Land Bank of the Philippines, shall prepare the necessary plans and measures to effect
the transfer of all programs, assets, liabilities and records of the NSF for the
management, administration and development of the new Livecor within thirty (30) days
from the issuance of this Executive Order.
The NLSF Secretariat, the new Livecer and the Transfer Committee shall jointly submit a
report to the Presidential Management Staft on all actins taken to implement the
provisions of this Executive Order within thirty (30) days after the new Livecor shall
have been re-organized;
SECTION &. Personnel - To ensure the continued implementation and management of
the NISF during the period of transfer and transition, the NLSF personnel who are
performing the functions transferred to the new Livecor shall be absorbed and shall
continue to perform such duties under the management of the new Livecor; provided, that
those personnel, at their option, may retire or be separated from the service from the
NLSF, and shall be entitled to the benefits provided by law at the time of retirement or
separation. The same option shall be made available to the Livecor personnel

Operation Expenses. - The operating expenses of the new Livecor shall he
charged against the income generated by the NLSF and the liquidation of the assets of

Existing Policies and Rules. - Existing policies, guidelines, rules and
relations with respect to the functions of the NISF which have been transferred to the
new Livecor shall continue in effect until amended or modified accordingly.

Repealing Clause. - All executive issuances, guidelines, rales and
regulations, or parts thereof which are contrary or loconsistent with the provisions of this
Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Electivity: - This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
City of Manila, 22 November 2007
